hero_body: Meldiq Web is another device of your Meldiq account. Your messages are kept on Meldiq''s servers, so your phone and this computer always show the same chats.
hero_point_keys: Your password signs you in. Add a passkey or two-step sign-in for extra protection.
hero_point_remove: Remove this browser from any of your devices at any time; it signs out at once.
signin_email_sub: Use your Meldiq email and password.
signin_verify_sub: Enter a code from your authenticator app, or use a backup code.
signin_invite_sub: This server requires an invitation to create an account.
signin_provider_sub: Finish signing in in the {provider} window. You’ll continue here automatically.
signin_sub: Choose how to sign in to your account.
signin_old_server: This Meldiq server is older than email accounts. Link this browser with your phone instead.
help_sub: Choose what happened. What you typed stays here if you come back.
help_forgot_sub: We''ll email you a code to set a new one.
help_no_email: I can''t get into my email
help_no_email_sub: Use one of your saved recovery codes to move the account to a new address.
help_phone_sub: Haven''t moved your account yet? Approve this browser from your phone.
signup_sub: We''ll email you a code to confirm the address.
signup_name_hint: Shown to the people you talk to.
signup_password_hint: At least {n} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one.
signup_invite_hint: This server only admits people with an invitation.
verify_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It''s valid for 15 minutes.
verify_resent: If {email} is waiting for a code, a new one is on its way.
verify_enter: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
forgot_sub: We''ll email you a code. Resetting signs you out everywhere; your messages and keys stay on your devices.
reset_sent: If {email} has a Meldiq account, we sent it a reset code. It''s valid for 15 minutes.
reset_enter_code: Enter the code from the email.
reset_done: Your password was changed and every session signed out. Sign in with the new one.
reauth_sub: Your session on this browser ended. Enter the password for {email} to continue where you left off.
reauth_other_email: Your account uses a different email now?
